overall.verdict: The dark desktop shell is calm and the right shape — rail, hero total, Pay two-column, Activity master-detail — but it is not yet a shipping wallet: money bars stretch to the card instead of the promised 1px=$N scale, Receive/Account/Swap are centered mobile columns, and a leftover 'Payment submitted' toast contradicts the PAID receipt. Until bars are comparable and the paid state is singular, the product’s own differentiators (visceral value, provable instant settlement) do not show up on screen.
priority_fixes: Honor Settings 1px=$N on every money bar (Home USDC, Hub One send/receive, Pay Before/After, Activity rows); compose the send half from credit line + collateral + owed; clip overflow instead of filling the card; delete the Receive 0.00 gradient.
One payment state: dismiss 'Payment submitted: 25.00 USDC to Meridian Desk' as soon as PAID is shown — Receipt, Receive, Swap, Account, Activity (07) all still carry it.
Give Receive, Account, and Swap real two-column desktop layouts (QR|share, position|ledger, pair|quote); stop parking a ~420px mobile stack on the canvas.
Pay: one route (right graph), one fee with hop math, one account viz (Before/After); drop in-form chips, the duplicate bar, and the sandbox badge on You.
Receipt (03) and Activity detail (08): one frame id, one timestamp, copyable proof, one verb (Paid/Settled) — not #40 vs #41, 2038 ms vs 00:27:30 vs submitted.
